description: Curated material database for materials that are not uniquely represented by a PubChem compound. Compositions are given as formulas (preferred, fractions derived automatically) or reference an entry of the NIST ESTAR composition table. Densities are only given where a source is available; 'estar_id' densities are read from the NIST table at load time.

presets.name: DGEBA epoxy resin (uncured, n = 0)
presets.composition_source: Molecular formula of bisphenol A diglycidyl ether (DGEBA monomer)
presets.notes: Uncured resin only; ignores hardener. Real formulations contain oligomers (n > 0), hardeners, diluents and additives.

presets.name: DGEBA cured with DETA (stoichiometric, idealised)
presets.composition_source: Derived: 5 DGEBA (C21H24O4, 2 epoxide groups) + 2 diethylenetriamine (C4H13N3, 5 amine H) = 10 epoxide : 10 N-H (stoichiometric). No atoms are lost on curing (addition reaction).
presets.notes: Idealised stoichiometric network. Actual resin/hardener ratio, oligomer content and additives change the composition.

presets.name: DGEBA cured with IPDA (stoichiometric, idealised)
presets.composition_source: Derived: 2 DGEBA (C21H24O4, 2 epoxide groups) + 1 isophorone diamine (C10H22N2, 4 amine H) = 4 epoxide : 4 N-H (stoichiometric). Addition reaction, no atoms lost.
presets.notes: Idealised stoichiometric network. Actual formulations differ.

families.warning: Concrete composition and density vary widely with mix design and aggregate. The NIST composition is a reference example only.

families.name: Lead glass
families.warning: Lead glass PbO content varies from a few % to over 70 %. Use the manufacturer's composition if available.

families.name: Glass
families.warning: 'Glass' covers many compositions. Choose a preset or define a custom composition.

families.name: Borated polyethylene
families.warning: Boron content (and whether boron is added as B, B4C or boric oxide) depends on the product. Enter it as a composite, e.g. 'x wt% B4C + (100-x) wt% polyethylene', with the manufacturer's value.
